name: Projectile Lab
desc: A projectile-motion lab: launch speed, angle and quadratic air drag drive the flight, with the no-drag parabola shown for comparison and four planetary gravities.
controls: Launch-speed, angle and drag sliders, four gravity presets (Earth/Mars/Moon/Jupiter), launch/reset buttons, trail toggle, click-to-aim; keys 1–4 switch planets, Space launches, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
